title: Self-Assembled Monolayers of Thiolates on Metals as a Form of Nanotechnology
method_used: Critical review of monolayer preparation, structure, defects, and interfacial properties.
metric_reused_here: Conceptual separation of adsorption, molecular organization, and defect-sensitive monolayer quality.
applicability: Provides the foundational framework used to interpret solvent-dependent pre-adsorption behavior.
limitations: Thiol/metal systems differ chemically from phosphonic-acid SAMs, and the present trajectories contain no substrate.

title: Formation and Structure of Self-Assembled Monolayers
method_used: Review of substrate-adsorbate bonding, intermolecular forces, packing, and structural characterization.
metric_reused_here: Interaction-based interpretation of solvent effects on molecular organization.
applicability: Supports treating solvent effects as a balance of headgroup, tail, and intermolecular interactions.
limitations: A general review rather than a trajectory-analysis protocol for OPA in solution.

title: Guidelines for the Fitting of Anomalous Diffusion Mean Square Displacement Graphs from Single Particle Tracking Experiments
system: Short single-particle trajectories with anomalous diffusion
method_used: Assessment of time-averaged MSD fitting range and bias for short/noisy trajectories.
metric_reused_here: Time-averaged MSD and a restricted-lag log-log anomalous exponent fit with fit-quality reporting.
applicability: Directly informs cautious fitting of the 101-frame OPA center-of-mass trajectories.
limitations: The trajectories here are molecular dynamics data and only 10 ps long; alpha is descriptive, not a converged transport exponent.

title: Application of Molecular Dynamics Simulations in Molecular Property Prediction II: Diffusion Coefficient
method_used: Einstein-relation MSD analysis with convergence and trajectory-length assessment.
metric_reused_here: Unwrapped center-of-mass MSD as a relative mobility descriptor.
applicability: Supports the core translational-motion calculation and its physical interpretation.
limitations: Published convergence guidance is far longer than 10 ps, so no absolute diffusion coefficient is claimed.

title: Solvent Dependence of the Self-Assembly Process of an Endgroup-Modified Alkanethiol
system: Endgroup-modified alkanethiol assembly from ethanol and hexane
method_used: In situ time-resolved second-harmonic generation to resolve coverage and orientation kinetics.
metric_reused_here: Separate consideration of molecular motion and orientation/organization rather than a single solvent score.
applicability: Direct experimental evidence that assembly kinetics can depend strongly on solvent identity.
limitations: Different headgroup/substrate chemistry; the current solution-only simulations cannot measure surface coverage.

title: Effect of Concentration, Chain Length, Hydrophobicity, and an External Electric Field on the Growth of Mixed Alkanethiol Self-Assembled Monolayers: A Molecular Dynamics Study
system: Mixed alkanethiol SAM growth at several concentrations
method_used: Molecular dynamics of concentration-dependent growth, coverage, nonbonded ligand-solvent energy, and trapped-solvent defects.
metric_reused_here: Concentration-series trend analysis and ligand-solvent force descriptors.
applicability: Closest methodological precedent for the same-component/different-concentration comparison.
limitations: Includes an explicit surface and multiple ligands, whereas each present trajectory has one OPA and no surface.

title: Molecular Dynamics Simulations of Phosphonic Acid-Aluminum Oxide Self-Organization and Their Evolution into Ordered Monolayers
system: Octadecylphosphonic acid on aluminum oxide in 2-propanol, hexane, and vacuum
method_used: Gradual docking/assembly followed by nanosecond molecular dynamics and solvent comparison.
metric_reused_here: Phosphonic-acid-specific solvent comparison and headgroup-versus-tail interpretation.
applicability: Most chemically relevant precedent because it studies long-chain phosphonic acid and contrasts polar and nonpolar solvents.
limitations: Its explicit oxide surface and nanosecond assembly stage are absent from the present 10 ps pre-adsorption trajectories.

title: Theoretical Insights into the Solvent Polarity Effect on the Quality of Self-Assembled N-Octadecanethiol Monolayers on Cu (111) Surfaces
system: N-octadecanethiol on Cu(111) in solvents of different polarity
method_used: First-principles adsorption analysis plus molecular-dynamics radial distribution functions between terminal groups and solvent.
metric_reused_here: Species-resolved RDF, coordination number, and head/tail local enrichment.
applicability: Direct methodological support for measuring preferential solvation around different ligand regions.
limitations: Low citation count, thiol/Cu chemistry, and an explicit surface; retained because the RDF method is unusually direct.

title: Characterizing the Molecular Order of Phosphonic Acid Self-Assembled Monolayers on Indium Tin Oxide Surfaces
system: Phosphonic-acid SAMs on indium tin oxide
method_used: Near-edge X-ray absorption fine structure analysis of molecular order and tilt.
metric_reused_here: Defines experimentally meaningful SAM order/tilt endpoints for future validation.
applicability: Chemically relevant benchmark for what a completed phosphonic-acid monolayer should ultimately be evaluated against.
limitations: No comparable surface-order observable exists in the supplied solution-only trajectories.

title: Trajectory Analysis in Single-Particle Tracking: From Mean Squared Displacement to Machine Learning Approaches
method_used: Review of ensemble/time-averaged MSD, diffusion models, uncertainty, and classification approaches.
metric_reused_here: TAMSD definition and explicit reporting of short-trajectory limitations.
applicability: Provides a current methodological cross-check for the motion analysis.
limitations: A tracking-method review rather than a SAM-solvent study.
